blurb: The Arroyo Golf Club is an 18-hole Arnold Palmer golf course located in the Summerlin community of Las Vegas, near Red Rock Canyon. The course offers panoramic views of the Las Vegas cityscape and is suitable for both beginners and advanced players. It operates year-round with a focus on providing a tranquil environment close to city entertainment.
